page.title: Contract Checklist Tool
hero.title: Understand your Chinese contract before you sign it.
hero.lead: Upload an employment contract, apartment lease or business agreement. See what's missing and what's risky, with the exact clause it comes from.
demo.caption: Example result
demo.explanation: Under Chinese labour law, probation pay is generally at least 80% of the agreed salary. This clause sets it at 70%.
how.title: How it works
how.step1.title: Upload your contract
how.step1.text: A PDF or Word file, in Chinese or in two languages.
how.step2.title: We check it against a checklist
how.step2.text: Each contract type has its own list of key terms. Every finding quotes the clause it is based on.
how.step3.title: Read the results in your language
how.step3.text: English, Spanish or Chinese, with risks marked and a plain-language explanation of each clause.
types.title: What we check
types.lead: Choose the type that matches your contract.
types.employment.text: For jobs in China: contract term, probation, pay and how the contract can end.
types.lease.text: For renting a home: rent, deposit, repairs and leaving early.
types.business.text: For deals between companies: payment, liability and disputes.
privacy.title: Your contract stays private
privacy.lead: We read your file to check it, and then it's gone.
privacy.point1: Your file is processed in memory and never saved.
privacy.point2: Contract text is never written to our logs.
privacy.point3: To check it, the text is sent to our AI provider, DeepSeek.
lawyer.title: Need a lawyer?
lawyer.text: After your check, you can send a short message to a lawyer from the results page. Your contract is never attached.
check.title: Check your contract
check.lead: Upload a contract written in Chinese. We list what's missing and what's risky, quoting the exact clause.
upload.file_hint: PDF or DOCX, up to 10 MB
footer.independent: An independent personal project. Not affiliated with any law firm or government body.
language.label: Language
disclaimer: This is an automated checklist, not legal advice.
status.checking: Checking the contract… this can take up to a minute.
results.title: Results
results.summary: {total} items checked · {high} high risk · {check} to check manually
results.reupload: To see these results in {language}, please upload the file again.
contact.title: Get help from a lawyer
contact.highlight: This contract has high-risk items. A lawyer can review them with you.
contact.name: Name
contact.summary_option: Include my checklist summary (item names, status and risk only, never contract text)
contact.consent: I agree that my name, email and message are sent to a lawyer so they can contact me. My contract is not sent.
contact.sent: Message sent. You'll get a reply by email.
